# Extract the data for each country group
sub_saharan_africa_education = education_expenditure_series[education_expenditure_series['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
lower_middle_income_education = education_expenditure_series[education_expenditure_series['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

sub_saharan_africa_gdp = gdp_series[gdp_series['Country Group'] == 'Sub-Saharan Africa']
lower_middle_income_gdp = gdp_series[gdp_series['Country Group'] == 'Lower middle income']

# Extract the values for the years 1975 to 2015
sub_saharan_africa_education_values = sub_saharan_africa_education.iloc[:, 4:].values.flatten()
lower_middle_income_education_values = lower_middle_income_education.iloc[:, 4:].values.flatten()

sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values = sub_saharan_africa_gdp.iloc[:, 4:].values.flatten()
lower_middle_income_gdp_values = lower_middle_income_gdp.iloc[:, 4:].values.flatten()

# Calculate the correlation coefficients
import numpy as np

correlation_sub_saharan = np.corrcoef(sub_saharan_africa_education_values, sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values)[0, 1]
correlation_lower_middle = np.corrcoef(lower_middle_income_education_values, lower_middle_income_gdp_values)[0, 1]

correlation_sub_saharan, correlation_lower_middle

# Check for missing data in Sub-Saharan Africa education and GDP values
import numpy as np

sub_saharan_africa_education_missing = np.isnan(sub_saharan_africa_education_values).sum()
sub_saharan_africa_gdp_missing = np.isnan(sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values).sum()

sub_saharan_africa_education_missing, sub_saharan_africa_gdp_missing

# Impute missing values in Sub-Saharan Africa GDP data
sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values_imputed = np.where(np.isnan(sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values), np.nanmean(sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values), sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values)

# Recalculate the correlation coefficient for Sub-Saharan Africa
correlation_sub_saharan_imputed = np.corrcoef(sub_saharan_africa_education_values, sub_saharan_africa_gdp_values_imputed)[0, 1]
correlation_sub_saharan_imputed
